notes: MACULA reads ʾōnî as an absolute noun with no suffix, so the my of in my mourning is added under rule 18's closing sentence.

The being of being unclean is given to the circumstantial bə under rule 11, a present function morpheme taking the English whose sense it carries; the competing reading marks the preposition unrepresented and gives being unclean whole to the adjective under rule 20.
The three mimmennû's each fuse preposition and suffix in thereof, headed on the preposition since no relative stands in these clauses (rules 22, 30).
